table.name: Opportunity
table.customFieldJoin: left join $.crmcustomfields ocf on t.customFields_id = ocf.id

sqlquery.from:
(SELECT distinct op.id,op.number, (mu.firstname || ' ' || mu.lastname) as assignee, op.name as opportunityname, op.amount as amount, stg.name as stage, op.nextstep as nextstep , op.closingdate as closingdate, cac.name as accountname, lds.name as leadsource, cgn.name as campaignname , typ.name as typename , (cco.firstName||' '||cco.lastname) as contact, op.probability as probability, op.expectedrevenue as expectedrevenue, opitem.itemname as opitemname, opitem.qty as opitemqty, opitem.price as opitemprice ,addr.countryname countryname ,replace(replace(replace(replace(note.comment,';',''),E'\r',''),E'\n',''),',','') as notecomment, op.deleted as deleted ,op.customFields_id
from "$".opportunity AS op LEFT JOIN "$".myuser mu ON mu.id = op.owner LEFT JOIN "$".crmaccount cac ON cac.id = op.crmaccount LEFT JOIN "$".reference lds on lds.id = op.leadsource LEFT JOIN "$".campaign cgn on cgn.id = op.campaign LEFT JOIN "$".reference typ on typ.id = op.type LEFT JOIN "$".crmcontact cco ON cco.id = op.crmcontact LEFT JOIN "$".reference stg on stg.id = op.stage LEFT JOIN "$".opportunity_item opitem on op.id=opitem.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN (select note2.opportunity_id, note2.comment from (select max(note.id) max_id from "$".crmNoteHistory note group by note.opportunity_id) note inner join "$".crmNoteHistory note2 on note.max_id=note2.id) note on op.id=note.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN (select max(c.name) countryname ,addr.accountid from country c left join "$".address addr on c.id = addr.countryid where addr.countryid is not null group by addr.accountid ) addr on cac.id=accountid where op.deleted is not true ) t
